name: Backblaze B2 Cloud Storage Free
free_limit: First 10 GB of B2 object storage always free; free egress up to 3x average monthly stored bytes; Class A, B and C API transactions free.
watch_out: Storage beyond 10 GB is billed at $6.95/TB/month; non-partner egress beyond 3x average storage is $0.01/GB. Class D events exceed free 2,500/day at $0.004 per 10,000. Set spending safeguards before adding payment details; explicit commercial use rights for the free allowance are not separately stated.
